description.value: Rocky Point Ice Cream is a family-owned artisan ice cream chain that has operated in the Lower Mainland since 1997, making its own ice cream from scratch at BC's first licensed dairy plant dedicated solely to craft production. The New Westminster location is one of four storefront locations across the region and offers both indoor and outdoor seating. Visitors can choose from a rotating lineup of house-made flavours including plant-based and sorbet options.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 29m; stands (2 spaces) at 76m; stands at 83m; stands (3 spaces) at 99m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Rocky Point Ice Cream as a real, active multi-location business founded in 1997 with a New Westminster location at 500 6th Ave. #100 (matching OSM address exactly, per the /awards subpage). Plant-based options are explicitly named on the front page, and the shop section lists take-home pints and cakes confirming takeout. No evidence exists on the website for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging; OSM tags add indoor_seating=yes and outdoor_seating=yes but no cycling-specific amenities.
